from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingConstructionRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single month's housing construction data extracted from a statistical release."""
    year: int = Field(description="The calendar year the data represents (e.g., 2022)")
    month: int = Field(description="The calendar month (1-12) the data represents")
    starts_saar: float = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    completions_saar: float = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Completions")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Release date of the report containing this data (YYYY-MM-DD), used to resolve data precedence")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_records: list[HousingConstructionRecord]
